dataset: 80 procedural synthetic cases; 8 scenarios × 10 texture seeds. Correlated fixtures, not independent field data.
measurement: Local vision engine only, including PNG encoding. Excludes HTTP, storage, Lambda cold starts and network.
limitations: Fixed thresholds tuned on these synthetic fixture families.
No real-world accuracy, defect classification, or AWS benchmark claimed.
Low-contrast and tiny defects may be missed; lighting and viewpoint changes may cause false alarms.
